name: chronicles-of-fortuna-dokapon
description: Dokapon Kingdom style 2.5D Isometric Pixel RPG Board Game

scripts.gen:buildings: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/prepare-test-build.cjs && node scripts/generate_building_sprites.cjs --sheet
scripts.gen:foliage: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/prepare-test-build.cjs && node scripts/generate_foliage_sprites.cjs --sheet
scripts.gen:art: npm run gen:buildings && npm run gen:foliage
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run check:css
